{{Quote|Now that's what I call a victory, little brother! There'll be medals in this for both of us!|X1 to X2|<ref name="ES DS" />}}
The '''Invasion of Tatooine''' was a battle that took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Before attacking the planet, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used a [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|drone ship]] to deploy a [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] patrol consisting of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] on the surface. The patrol, however, was quickly destroyed by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[X2]], who, along with his [[DNA/Legends|genetic]] "brother" [[X1]], had been recently assigned to the Republic [[Tatooine training grounds|training grounds]] on the surface, under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ferroda]]. The Confederacy followed with a major attack, both in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and [[Ground warfare/Legends|on the ground]]. X2 played a crucial role in the battle on the ground, destroying several [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]] and using a [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 anti-orbital ion cannon]] to bring down the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of a Confederate [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].

Boarding [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-Wing starfighters]], X1 and X2 joined the [[Space warfare/Legends|space battle]]. X2 and several other clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] infiltrated the disabled [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]. Once there, X2 destroyed the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] with a [[HH-15 projectile launcher|rocket launcher]], setting a chain reaction that resulted in the carrier's explosion and securing a victory for the Republic. For their performance during the battle, X1 and X2 were invited to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where they were awarded medals by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Welcome to Tatooine, X2. I am Ferroda, the Jedi General in charge of this Republic battalion. You'll be helping your brother, X1, train the latest batch of clones in the art of galactic warfare.|Ferroda greets X2|<ref name="ES DS" />}}
[[File:X2-1.jpg|thumb|left|148px|X2 was crucial in repelling the Confederate recon force.]]
By the late stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ES DS" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had established [[Tatooine training grounds|special training grounds]] for its [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The training grounds were overseen by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ferroda]].<ref name="ES PSP" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ES DS" /> two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] different from the rest of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Army/Legends|army]], [[X1]] and [[X2]]—who had been secretly cloned from the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Falon Grey]] and demonstrated great skills throughout the conflict—were assigned to help [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Ferroda in training the latest batch of clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. X1 was the first to arrive on the planet, while X2 arrived later. When he reached the training grounds, X2, under X1's guidance, ran a training course for the new [[Troop/Legends|troopers]], teaching them the basics of shooting and melee combat.<ref name="ES PSP" />

His course was interrupted, however, when the clone troopers spotted a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] inside a Republic [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. X2 destroyed it, but the probe turned out to be a part of a larger [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] patrol. Taking control of an [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]], X2 destroyed the remaining probes. He then boarded a [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-Wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and took off into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], following the [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|drone ship]] from which the droids had been deployed. X2 destroyed the ship, thus dealing with the Confederate threat. However, X1 and X2 realized that a full scale Confederate invasion was imminent.<ref name="ES PSP" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Come in, X2! The CIS have hit us pretty hard. Our pilots are pinned down in the bunker. Give them some support.|Ferroda|<ref name="ES DS" />}}
Republic forces on the planet were ultimately hit by a heavy Confederate assault. Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] stationed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] engaged Confederate [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers]], while the enemy landed a large invasion force [[Ground warfare/Legends|on the surface]], complete with [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]], which pinned Republic [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] down in a bunker. X1 and X2 helped the clone [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to fight off the attacking [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. However, they did not possess heavy weaponry necessary to deal with the spider [[Droid/Legends|droids]], so they had to divert to a nearby droid-infested [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in order to bypass the enemy. Once the cantina had been secured, X2 was provided with a [[HH-15 projectile launcher|rocket launcher]] by a fellow clone and was then able to destroy the spider [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] one by one. As the battle continued to rage, the Confederacy began deploying more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], including [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], onto the field by way of their drone [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. X1, however, called in reinforcements, and the clone troopers were able to fight off the droids.<ref name="ES PSP" />

[[File:Battleovee-Tatooine.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The battle in space]]
Eventually, the Confederacy started sending in their [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] to bombard Republic positions. On Ferroda's orders, X2 manned an [[anti-aircraft gun]] and shot the enemy ships down. Once this was accomplished, effort was placed into destroying a Confederate [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] by use of a [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 anti-orbital ion cannon]] in order to drop its [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. X2 did so and proceeded along with his brother and several other clones to a Republic hangar. After clearing it of droids, X1 and X2 obtained a V-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] each and used them to join the [[Space warfare/Legends|space battle]]. The two clones went into orbit, where they destroyed the enemy fighter escorts protecting the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] with the downed shields. X2 and a number of other clones then landed inside the ship and fought through a large number of enemy droids to the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], which X2 destroyed with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]]. This resulted in the ship's core reaching critical mass and exploding as X2 and the clones escaped from the ship in their fighters. The act secured the Republic's victory in the battle.<ref name="ES PSP" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|These two honorable clone warriors are to be commended. Their courage and determination have allowed us to stand firm in the face of the Separatist menace time and again. On behalf of the Republic, I thank you.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine|<ref name="ES DS" />}}
The bravery demonstrated by X1 and X2 during the battle did not go unnoticed. The two clone brothers were invited by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to receive medals. The award ceremony was cut short, however, when the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attacked]] Coruscant. X1 and X2 assisted the Republic forces during the invasion, helping to successfully repel it.<ref name="ES DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Dialogue|X2|What the—?! CIS Vulture ships!|X1|It's an invasion! Move! Let's go, little brother! This is no training!|Ferroda|X1, X2, do you read me? Come in!|X2|Yes, Master Ferroda, we read you, what is it?|X1|General, we're aware of the situation. We're taking action now.|Ferroda|X1, I need you to…|X1|Come on! We need to get to the garrison!|attr=X1 and X2 communicating with Ferroda when the transmission breaks|src=<ref name="ES DS" />}}
[[File:CIS_makes_a_surprise_attack.jpg|thumb|left|300px|X2 and X1 witness the beginning of the invasion in the Nintendo DS version.]]
The Invasion of Tatooine was featured as the first level in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' for the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]]<ref name="ES PSP" /> and the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]]. The [[canon]]ical name "Invasion of Tatooine" was established in the latter version.<ref name="ES DS" /> There are many contradictions in the portrayal of the battle between the two console versions. Although the PSP version claims that the battle was an "early victory" for the Republic,<ref name="ES PSP" /> the Nintendo DS establishes that it took place in 19 BBY, shortly before the Battle of Coruscant. This article therefore uses the 19 BBY date provided in the Nintendo DS version,<ref name="ES DS" /> but describes the battle itself as depicted in the PSP version.<ref name="ES PSP" /> In the Nintendo DS edition, X1 and X2 are assigned to oversee the construction of an outpost instead of training new troopers. The two are busy working on the outpost when the Confederate attack begins, and they are completely surprised by it. After Ferroda has requested their assistance, they make their way to an invaded Republic garrison, helping the clone troopers they encounter on their way, and clear it from droids. The two then take [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] to an outpost across the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] where they rendezvous with Ferroda. Alongside the Jedi, X1 and X2 fight their way to a hangar and take [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] into space. There, X2 infiltrates a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] instead of a ''Providence''-class destroyer.<ref name="ES DS" />
